extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (NordVPN, PIA, Custom)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for LibreELEC. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), and Custom configurations. Features an automated Systemd watchdog to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for LibreELEC. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news: v1.4.8 (2026-06-10) - Added new WireGuard AllowedIPs Mode setting to prevent ConnMan gateway routing locks - Implemented dynamic 8-CIDR block matrix to bypass local network footprints on trouble regions - Implemented real-time Path MTU Discovery to dynamically eliminate packet fragmentation loops on restrictive networks. - Resolved timing lock loops on Raspberry Pi 5 by managing asynchronous ConnMan routing engine states. - Re-architected connection handlers to enforce secure thread isolation via dynamic file locking boundaries. - Optimized network recovery tracking to resolve runtime device configurations over native kernel structures. - Streamlined fallback lookup sequences to handle connection states over synchronized platform profiles. - Added safety check to prevent stripping DNS settings from users with static IP configurations. - Patched factory reset routines to explicitly cancel active settings windows before reloading to prevent un-saved configuration overwrites. - Optimized profile string matching loops to utilize a zero-overhead local JSON dictionary mapping database instead of complex string parsing.
